title: A named townsperson (D187, D188): rolled from their id, the same in every game; anything written here wins over the roll

sex.description: The list their first name comes from: m or f. Rolled if left out.

name.description: Their first name. Rolled from their people's list if left out.

surname.description: Their surname, shown when they have no role. Rolled if left out.

role.description: What they are, shown as `Name the Role` (D188): Alchemist, Innkeeper.

look.description: Parts of their look written out, each winning over the roll (D187): head, skin, ears, eyes, eyeColour, brows, nose, mouth, beard, tusks, hair, hairColour, hat, clothes. The options per people are PARTS in src/engine/looks.js; `npm run content` checks them.
